\section{Working memory on the final 510-subject cohort}
All reported performance estimates are obtained by repeated nested cross-validation within the final 510-subject cohort; no separate external validation cohort is claimed.

The R0 backbone reaches $r=0.243$ and SPSEF-Ridge reaches $r=0.244$ ($\Delta r=+0.001$, 3/5 seeds positive). RIDGE_PREDICTION_LEVEL is P1; BIOMARKER_LEVEL is B0. Architecture-matched cross-task, shuffled, and random prior controls are reported in Table~\ref{tab:final510_wm_prediction}.
